propositions: The complexity baseline file lacks a CI lock mechanism, allowing any contributor to modify it without administrator review, unlike the module-size limit which is gated in _build-and-test.yml

The baseline can grow silently by adding new high-complexity function entries; the existing test guards schema and entry count matching but does not prevent adding entries that were not previously baseline tracked

A semantic (not byte-equality) lock must distinguish legitimate shrinkage (entry removal or ceiling lowering) from illegitimate growth (entry addition or ceiling raising), failing closed on the latter and requiring admin override
The module-size limit lock fails open with a warning when git fetch of main fails, allowing unverified changes to pass; both locks must fail closed when the base value cannot be established
A new high-complexity function admitted in the same change as its baseline entry addition must be rejected by CI even though the baseline count and staleness checks would otherwise pass
